entries.zh: 捏造假状纸兴讼诬告；“状手”指代写状子、专以词讼为业之人
entries.en: to fabricate a false (legal) complaint; a complaint-hand: one skilled at drawing up false petitions
entries.notes: “脚”字功能待考（疑作“假”解），整体取 levantar falso（捏造诬状）与“生＋状”互证之义。

entries.zh: 生状：捏造状纸，无端兴讼诬告
entries.en: to fabricate a complaint; to institute a lawsuit on false grounds

entries.zh: 生言：凭空编造言语、造谣
entries.en: to invent words; spread fabricated statements

entries.zh: 生事：惹是生非、寻衅滋事
entries.en: to stir up trouble; make mischief

entries.zh: 诬指：捏造罪名指控、诬赖他人
entries.en: to accuse falsely; to make a false charge against someone

entries.zh: 诬害：诬陷加害于人
entries.en: to slander so as to injure; to frame someone

entries.zh: 亏心事：违背良心、于心有愧之事
entries.en: an act that wrongs one's conscience; a guilty deed

entries.zh: 造言：编造谣言、造言生事
entries.en: to fabricate words; spread rumors and stir up trouble with invented talk

entries.zh: 状话：告状之词、诬控言语
entries.en: words of a complaint; accusatory talk

entries.zh: 状景：情状、光景
entries.en: appearance; state of things
entries.notes: 闽南语栏后段混入无法解读的西语字样 contrahaza bu lasiss，释义仅据汉字“状景”与词头语境。

entries.zh: 状言：具状控告之词
entries.en: words of a complaint; statements made in a petition

entries.zh: 状事害：捏造事端、具状陷害
entries.en: to invent a matter and file charges so as to ruin someone

entries.zh: 阴谋：暗中谋划、密计陷害
entries.en: secret plot; conspiracy; scheme
entries.notes: 首字原件有“陰/僉”之疑，按“陰謀”取义。

entries.zh: 口出恶言、糟蹋人（西语旁注 mala boca“恶口”）
entries.en: to speak ill, bad-mouth (Spanish gloss in the text: mala boca)
entries.notes: “口斗怯”为非通行写法且“怯”与读音不合，据闽南语栏内嵌西语 mala boca 定为口出恶言。

entries.zh: 陷害人：设谋坑害他人
entries.en: to entrap and harm people; to frame someone

entries.zh: 虚谤、毁谤：造谣诽谤中伤
entries.en: false slander; to defame (Spanish disfamar, i.e. difamar)

entries.zh: 谤尽嚷：极口诽谤、嚷得满城皆知
entries.en: to slander to the utmost, shouting it abroad
entries.notes: 词头 laro del pueblo（下条同作 lauz）未能确解，或指市井喧闹、或谓此为民间惯习；释义以汉字为准。

entries.zh: 谤尽闹：极口诽谤、闹得阖境不安
entries.en: to slander to the utmost, raising an uproar in the town
entries.notes: 同上条，词头 lauz del pueblo 未能确解。

entries.zh: 口贱：出言轻贱、以口糟践人
entries.en: base-mouthed; to speak contemptibly of others
entries.notes: “口斗”为“喙（嘴）”之非通行写法，据第 14 条同类结构推断。

entries.zh: 采起采倒：拿起又放下、搬上搬下（多指反复搬弄货物）
entries.en: to pick up and set down; hoist and lay down (said of handling goods)
entries.notes: 词头 bolear la baxa 读解未定；释义以汉字与闽南语“采起采倒”为准，并结合马尼拉贸易语境取搬运义。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 词头 Lexia 与汉字“观”（闽南语三音节 kuí-kí-tsiok）无法互证，疑跨页断头或栏文缺损，语义无法定夺。
